title: Dashboard
purpose: See the work waiting for your laboratory roles and open the queue that needs attention.
summary: The work waiting for your roles, grouped by laboratory area, and the samples received most recently.

tasks.title: Start on the work that is waiting
steps: Find the line for your area under Your work queues.
Select a queue's label to open the list of those items. Queues showing 0 have no link.

tasks.title: Receive a shipment
steps: Select [[Receive samples]]. A new chain of custody opens for the actual receipt.

tasks.title: Open a recently received sample
steps: Under Recently received, select the Lab ID. Select [[All samples]] for the complete list.

good_to_know: Counts are live and count different things: samples, tests, batches, reports or records. Do not add them across queues.
A batch with only your own results is noted separately. Another reviewer must review it.
A delivery target is the date agreed with the client. It is separate from a method holding time.
The colour of a line only marks its area. The status and icon tell you the state.
Announcements cannot be dismissed. They disappear when they end or are withdrawn.

items.label: Announcements
items.description: Current notices the laboratory’s administrators posted for staff appear first, newest first, each marked Notice or Important with a title and a plain-text message. They are the same for every staff role, cannot be dismissed, and disappear when they end or are withdrawn. Nothing appears when none is current. Announcements for the sign-in page or the client portal are not repeated here unless they were also posted for staff. Administrators manage them under Setup, Announcements.

items.label: Receive samples
items.description: Opens a new chain of custody for actual receipt. Available to custodians and project managers, including the admin role’s operational access.

items.label: Your work queues
items.description: Your queues, grouped into lines by laboratory area: Intake, Sales, Bench, Release and Laboratory, in work order. Each line shows its area’s total. An area appears only when one of your roles has a queue there. The header shows how many items wait in all your queues together. A queue’s label opens the corresponding filtered list when its count is nonzero. Empty queues stay on their line with a muted label and 0, without a link. “Nothing is waiting for you right now” means all your displayed queues are zero.

items.label: Recently received / All samples
items.description: Shows the ten most recently received samples across the laboratory. Lab ID opens the sample; All samples opens the complete sample list, including for staff whose sidebar omits Samples. These links retain the sample pages’ access checks. There are no dashboard search, sorting or paging controls.

items.label: Queue
items.description: Type of work, with notes about conditions or items requiring another person. Opens the filtered list while the count is above zero.

items.label: Status
items.description: Shown while work waits: Needs a decision (samples on hold), Waiting, In review, Returned, At risk, Changed, Open, Due, Needs attention or Overdue, with the matching tone and icon. The line colours only mark the area; they never mean a status.

items.label: Oldest
items.description: Age of the earliest relevant timestamp when that queue supplies one. Hover over it for the exact time.

items.label: Count
items.description: Computed number of records matching that queue’s filters. Different queues count samples, tests, batches, reports or laboratory records; these counts are not interchangeable.

items.label: Samples on hold at receipt
items.description: Receipt disposition is Hold. Each sample needs a disposition decision.

items.label: Client submissions to accept
items.description: Only client submissions in Submitted status.

items.label: Tests past their delivery target
items.description: Delivery target is at or before now; excludes Reported stage and rejected samples. Delivery targets are separate from method holding times.

items.label: Draft quotes
items.description: Quotes in Draft status, shown to staff who can manage quotations.

items.label: Tests not yet in a batch / awaiting entry / returned
items.description: Analyst queues use the analytical worklist’s eligibility and current result state.

items.label: Holding time at risk or expired
items.description: Uses the analytical worklist’s holding-time rule. The note counts already-expired work within the risk queue.

items.label: Batches awaiting technical review
items.description: Counts batches containing results this reviewer can review. A note identifies additional batches containing only the reviewer’s own results; another reviewer must act.

items.label: External source results awaiting review
items.description: Unreviewed latest subcontract results excluding those entered by the current reviewer. Own entries are reported separately in a note.

items.label: Draft reports / issued reports with changed results
items.description: Shown to preparers or explicit release-authority holders. Changed issued work requires an amendment; the released version remains unchanged.

items.label: Equipment overdue / expired materials on hand
items.description: Equipment uses calibration/maintenance due state; materials count active lots expired before today with quantity remaining.

items.label: Nonconformances assigned to me
items.description: Open records owned by the signed-in person, excluding Closed.

items.label: My training records
items.description: Own records not superseded by a renewal and either expired or current with expiry within 30 days.

items.label: Lab ID / Client sample ID
items.description: Laboratory accession and the client-supplied sample identity.

items.label: Client / project
items.description: The client and project linked through the sample’s order.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Sample material category used to select applicable tests and rules.

items.label: Received
items.description: Recorded laboratory receipt time in the deployment timezone.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Proceed, qualify, hold or reject decision controlling downstream eligibility.

items.label: Location
items.description: Current recorded custody/storage location.

sections.title: Access and records
paragraphs: Active internal users see queues for their effective roles; admin includes operational roles but does not imply report-release authority. The sidebar offers destinations for your work capabilities and combines them when you hold several roles. Related record links may open pages beyond those destinations when existing page permissions allow. Client-linked users are redirected to their own portal. Dashboard counts are live queries over the linked operational records, not saved tasks.
